model: frozen rating-model CNN trunk (float16 embeddings) -> fine-tuned BiLSTM + causal Bahdanau attention (initialized from the rating model) -> gated-attention MIL head over the suspect side's plies
weights_contents: lstm.*, attention.*, and the MIL head; the CNN trunk is the served rating checkpoint's own conv/bn layers (frozen during A4 training)
corpus: synthetic anomaly corpus v2 (data/anomaly_corpus_v2, Maia bands with Stockfish 16 / Lc0 substitutions, real countdown clocks)
split_description: the v2 split (train_anomaly_detector.make_split, seed 42): 70/15/15 stratified by (band, engine, rate), not twin-safe; bands 1300 and 1700 and substitution rate 10 percent withheld from training entirely. The withheld-band and withheld-rate conditions are the same games as under the grouped split

per_move_localization_withheld_band.note: per-move instance logits localize substituted moves at or below chance; the app does not use them for critical moves

flag: a board-level model may recognize engine-style moves directly; read with the withheld-band, low-rate and strength checks
